999.synopsis:
Tada Banri, a newly admitted student at a private law school in Tokyo, found himself completely lost after the opening ceremony, trying to find his way to the freshman orientation. At that moment, he ran into another lost freshman from the same school, Yanagisawa Mitsuo, and they hit it off at once.
Somehow arriving at their intended goal just on time, there appeared in front of the two a beautiful girl holding a bouquet of roses. The girl then whacked Mitsuo across the face with the bouquet and handed the flowers over to him. “Freshman, congratulations”, was all she said, and then she left.
The stylish, well dressed, perfect woman that had swung at Mitsuo was his childhood friend, Kaga Kouko. As children they had promised to marry each other one day, fulfilling their dreams. In order to escape from her, Mitsuo had gone out secretly and taken the examination for this well known private college, but now she showed up in the freshman orientation hall. She too had taken the law school entrance examination, catching up with him there.

There is an academy which trains such people (girls). One of the students there is a girl called Shirley. She’s the heroine of the story and her family was originally one of the four great nobles of her country until its downfall. For that reason she is isolated from other girls. After her many attempts, she manages to summon a servant. But this servant happens to be a boy who has lost his memories. Hayato is his name.
One of Shirley’s aims is to win the tournaments which will give the winner the title, Grantzveissen. It will allow Shirley to regain some of her family’s glory back. In order to participate in the tournament, she needs to get good results in battles arranged by the school.

A time of huge change and considerable turmoil was about to begin, a revolution that no man could turn a blind eye to.
In the ancient bronze era, even more distant than medieval times, a certain blacksmith was yet to make his great effort.

Why? Because her younger sister with both beauty and fame, whose personality was great, who held a mysterious power and who was a soothing miko had gotten into a marriage of love with said king. And Fii, her twin, had just come along with her as a set bonus.
She was treated as a stain on the fairy tale, but after a certain event, Fii decided she didn’t care any more.
She didn’t care about this lifestyle where she never saw her husband even once, where she would spend the rest of her days rotting away in a royal villa.

Iris, who was possessed by a hero comic she enjoyed reading before she died.
A gloomy Kyodam City where all kinds of villains run rampant.
The city with the lowest citizen happiness index in the world, the city that she least wants to live in, and a place with ominous rumors that you can enter however you want, but when you leave, even the mayor turns into a villain and demands money.
She was possessed by a common citizen of Kyodam City, a paradise for villains, and struggles to survive.
After 22 years of wishing to awaken her abilities by pinching wild dogs and cats, a c*astity belt she bought at an antique shop changed her fate…
“By the way, what is Iris’s hero name?”
“…Hero name? I, c*astity belt girl…”
“What a…great name.”
It’s good that she’s a hero, but the state of her skills is a bit strange?
She slowly lowered her head, wondering if it could be true.
Something golden, which seemed to be the same material as the c*astity belt’s chain, was sticking out from her skirt and coiling on the floor like a snake.
“Could this be… a whip?”
Iris swallowed hard and picked up the monster that had fallen to the floor.
Then, the chain that had been hanging limply became stiff and suddenly swung like a whip.
“This is a whip.”
Iris, who was getting stronger and more uglier as she went on hero missions, eventually caught the attention of the villains… .
“Isn’t… I shouldn’t be here? T-that’s right… I shouldn’t be here… I shouldn’t be here…”
The loner, a pure stalker who had a crush on Iris for 14 years.
“Huh, do you think I’ll do something harsh to you? Don’t fool around.”
The arrogant, scheming man who told her not to fool around but ended up falling for it even more, and
the mad scientist who was trying to put her in his collection.
Strange but charming villains, and the even stranger hero Iris who tried to get involved with charming men and extract their abilities since she’s already in this situation.
‘He who wears the crown, bear its weight.’
She tries to defeat the villains(?) for the peace of Kyodam City, but she finds out that there is a huge mastermind behind it…!
associated_names: I Plan to Suck out the Villains Marrow and Devour them

105447.synopsis:

She worked hard to make money, dreaming of counting cash until her hands cramped.
Then, she suddenly realized it was actually an apocalypse survival script.
She wanted to refuse.
But what choice did she have?
Following the principle that living shamelessly is better than dying, Ji He did her best to survive.
She worked during the day, dug tunnels at night, and even ventured into dungeons whenever she had time.
Operating on the rule of scavenging as much as possible—until she physically couldn’t—Ji He stuffed everything she could into her space.
By the time she came to her senses…
She had turned the apocalypse survival game into a business management one.

106471.synopsis:
Two years have passed since dungeons appeared in the world.
After causing chaos and upheaval, the world had finally begun to stabilize.
Kaede Obata, age thirty-two, made a bold decision—to walk away from his stable job and debut as a dungeon explorer.
As a hardcore otaku, Kaede had always dreamed of diving into a dungeon. But at the same time, he had no desire to die, nor did he believe he could achieve the kind of heroic feats seen in stories.
That was precisely why he waited.
He waited for the day when information had been gathered, when the risks had been assessed, and when he could explore safely with confidence.
And now, that day had come.
With his resignation finalized, Kaede took his first steps as an explorer—joined by two friends who, by sheer coincidence, had the exact same idea.
He had no grand ambitions of becoming a millionaire. No aspirations of becoming a hero.
A little thrill here and there, days off when he felt like it. Work when the mood struck, play when he felt like it.
His goal? A stress-free, carefree lifestyle.
He paid no mind to how others saw him—just a laid-back thirty-something dungeon explorer living life at his own pace.
(Note: Of course, just because that’s how he sees himself… doesn’t mean everyone else agrees.)

Cultivate demonic arts? Stir up trouble?
Neither. This innocent virg1n isn’t interested in destroying the world at all. He just wants to peacefully gather a few disciples.
But why do the disciples all want to do things with her?
Yin Qiushui: Young Palace Master is the best in the world.
Lu Xinyao: Elder Sister is just too alluring.

111335.synopsis:
“I’m not interested in becoming a soldier.”
“Should I kill your whole family, then? Maybe that’ll make you listen.”
Last night, he went out to earn some spare cash—and ran straight into the same lunatic killer who now, in a clean military uniform, introduces himself as Captain Kim Hayoon and hands over enlistment papers.
He thought he was being silenced. Instead, the madman was recruiting him.
“If you just follow orders, your entire family can live in comfort.”
His instincts screamed danger. This man was a threat—but the desperate grind of daily poverty made Kim Hayoon’s offer difficult to resist.
As a mixed-blood from Zone B, military life was hell from day one. Nothing came easy, and every moment felt like survival.
At first, he just wanted to get kicked out and go home. But thinking of his smiling younger siblings, and his adoptive father who had just survived a critical heart surgery, he began to understand what he had to do.
Kim Hayoon had given him more than he ever dared hope for. And so, he began to wonder—out of all the people in the world, why me?
But he couldn’t forget—
“Nothing in this world is free.”

113383.synopsis:
I Transmigrated As A Three-Year-Old Villain With A Redemption System?!
Su Yun transmigrated into a novel as the main villain—but arrived a thousand years too early!
He’s only three years old, so what the hell is this redemption system?
[After you fall into darkness, your mother dies from heartbreak. Please reverse causality and bring her back to life.] 
Su Yun looked at the healthy, stunningly beautiful woman—renowned as the most beautiful in the world—and tentatively called out, “Mother.”
[Mission complete. Reward: Beginningless Dao Bone!] 
But from that point on, the nature of the missions started to change.
[After slaughtering the sect, please find a successor for your master.] 
Master, what do you think? How about me as your successor?
[You bullied the Empress and killed her husband. Please find her a new Dao companion.] 
This little baby sucking on a lollipop is the Empress? She wants to play house and pretend to be a mom?
[You exterminated the demon race. Please search the River of Time for any surviving bloodlines.] 
Hey!

120807.synopsis:
Her younger sister turned into a gyaru and started coming on to me? (Yes, there’s some comeuppance too.)
After being betrayed and dumped by his girlfriend, the protagonist falls into despair. Just when he’s at his lowest, her younger sister suddenly shows up in front of him. For some reason, the once quiet and modest girl has transformed into a flashy gyaru overnight.
“Hey, Onii-san, w-wanna play some games with me?”
“That must’ve been really tough for you…”
Despite her dramatic change in appearance, her gentle and caring nature hasn’t changed. As she stays by his side, wholeheartedly supporting him, her warmth begins to heal his heart. Little by little, he finds comfort in her presence, and before he knows it, he starts to fall for her.
Meanwhile, the ex-girlfriend who betrayed him, along with the guy she cheated with, begins to spiral downward into ruin.

His talent was mediocre and the path to immortality seemed bleak.

From that moment on, Chen Jing’an focused on expanding his family tree, nurturing descendants, inheriting their gifts, and leading his clan from a humble Qi Refining family to rise step by step in the world of cultivation.
Pill refinement, artifact forging, array formation, talisman crafting… talents converged, and all paths led to mastery!

130791.synopsis:
I fell asleep while reading a novel, only to wake up as one of the characters in the book.
Of all people, I became Karin Wendis, the villainess who stands between the male lead Luke and the female lead Alicia!
‘What do I do now? And I didn’t even finish the book! I fell asleep before getting to the end!’
In the last part I read, Karin, the original owner of the body I possessed, was plotting to kill the heroine by locking her up and setting the place on fire.
‘No way, I won’t do it. I absolutely won’t!’
Fine, I’ll just make sure the male and female leads get together, stay out of trouble, and avoid being a villainess altogether!
Karin thought that if she did this, everything would work out.
* * *
After the attendants left, the door clicked shut. Luke, who had been staring at the door, slowly turned his gaze toward Karin. Her body flinched instinctively.
‘This… wasn’t supposed to happen. How did things end up like this?’
Something was wrong. By now, the male and female leads should have been happily together, and she should have been out of the picture. Instead, she found herself spending her first night with the male lead. Karin froze in place.
Luke’s lips curled into a faint smile.
“Why are you so tense?”
“…I don’t know about you, Your Grace, but this is my first time.”
“It’s not ‘Your Grace’ anymore, but ‘honey’ or ‘darling,’ isn’t it? Aren’t I your husband now?”
Luke stepped closer to Karin as he spoke.
“Relax.”
His lips curled into a smirk.

134631.synopsis:
A kind father. A noble and handsome fiancé.
Nanna envied and admired Thea, who had it all. But she never intended to steal or possess those things. From the beginning, they were not something that could be shared.
However, after Thea fell into an unexpected “sleep,” Nanna succeeded her and became the Emperor’s second Empress Consort. A tool for bearing an imperial heir.
After giving birth to three children, Thea miraculously woke up not long after. Nanna thought everything would return to the way it was….
“Speak your true feelings. You want me. You want to carry my child.”
The more she tried to escape, the more Emperor Orestes bound her.
“Will you marry me? Unlike Orestes, I will take you as my wife.”
Thea’s father, Duke Sermione of Everhardt, who once kept her as his mistress, sought to claim her.
Nanna didn’t want it. That was the truth. All she wished for was to start anew with a gentle man who looked only at her, to have a whole family.
Yet the two men dragged her life down once more….

150247.synopsis:
Zhang Qinghe had always been a top-tier overachiever. Her only hobbies were studying and making money.
Lately, though, her peaceful high school life had started to get a little… strange.
A new transfer student in her senior year—who looked every bit the delinquent—was blatantly following her around.
Even weirder, this so-called Zai Ye senior was always accompanied by a little girl. But the strangest part? No one else seemed to be able to see the girl—except her.
Zhang Qinghe: …Am I caught up in some kind of supernatural event?
But the real kicker came when Zai Ye declared that he was her future boss and lover, and that the little girl was their daughter, Qian.
The child clung to her leg affectionately, calling her “Mommy.”
Zhang Qinghe: Honestly, this is way scarier than any ghost story.
*Author Note*
*This is the spinoff series of “Slacker Second Gen Across Worlds,” featuring Qian, Chief Assistant Zhang, and the Zai Ye family.
*My friend wanted to read it, so I wrote it with tears in my eyes.
*If there are any inconsistencies with the original “Slacker Second Gen” novel… I forgot. Don’t worry about it.

166631.synopsis:
Cui Yi inexplicably transmigrated into a “sweet-pet” web novel as a background character a “Passerby A.” In the entire book, her only description was a single sentence mentioning her poor health. Honestly, Cui Yi was quite satisfied with this; it meant she didn’t have to get entangled in any messy plotlines.
However, a single accident turned her into cannon fodder in the power struggle between the protagonist and the villainess. She ended up locked in a room with the villainess, who had “tried to steal a chicken only to lose the rice”—getting outsmarted and accidentally poisoned by an aphrodisiac she intended for someone else. At that very moment, the female lead was leading a large crowd toward their location.
Cui Yi: “…”
Cui Yi went to great lengths to escape that disaster. Because of this, she developed a particularly bad impression of both the protagonist and the villainess for dragging her into their mess innocently. She resolved that wherever those two were, she would absolutely never go. Yet, to her surprise, the villainess came to her, stammering and claiming that Cui Yi had ruined her “innocence” and demanding she take responsibility.
Cui Yi, who had no intention of starting a family in this world: “…Fine.”
